## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check-types` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (and new behavior has a test where it makes sense)
- [ ] Added a changeset if this changes a published `@openacme/*` package (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] Updated `CLAUDE.md` / docs if this changes architecture, a public surface, or a gotcha
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or `auth.json` contents in the diff
